ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels comprise approximately 15% of the visible surface area, restricted to the distal tips, while low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprise the remaining 85% macro-surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches are localized to the upper distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe features a larger, fragmented mottle extending from the apex downward along the leading edge. The right lobe features a smaller, more solid white patch at the apex. The central peduncle region and proximal lobe surfaces are solid low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central notch is a sharp V-shape with a measured angle of approximately 35 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 1:5 relative to the vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness with pixel peaks corresponding to barnacle clusters. The left lobe trailing edge is comparatively smoother with low-amplitude, low-frequency wave-like serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both trailing edges exhibit a distinct convex trajectory curving outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast tan and white circular clusters (barnacles) are densely packed along the trailing edge of the right lobe and the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Several small, isolated white circular points are visible on the dark mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions are visible on the lower-central dark region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization along the periphery of the right lobe and both distal tips. Multiple small, circular depigmented scars are visible across the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Numerous high-intensity specular highlights caused by water droplets are distributed across the dark-pigmented central areas of the fluke.
